title: labconstrictor-app.yaml
description: Manifest that an app keeps in the root of its own repository so that it can be listed in the LabConstrictor App Centre. Edit it with schema support: add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://labconstrictor.cellmig.org/schema/labconstrictor-app.schema.json` as the first line.

name.description: Display name, as users know the app.

summary.description: One sentence shown on the app card. Plain text.

description.description: A few plain-text paragraphs shown on the app page; separate paragraphs with a blank line. No HTML or Markdown.

quickstart.description: Up to six short plain-text steps for a first run, shown on the app page. Link to fuller documentation with docs_url.

kind.description: What the app is for; drives the filter on the App Centre.

hosts.description: Where the app's tools can be used besides its own window (the LabConstrictor-Tools bridge).

distribution.description: How people get the app. At least one route is required.

installer.description: The latest GitHub release carries LabConstrictor installers (Name-version-OS-arch.ext).

pip.description: Name of the package on PyPI.

doi.description: DOI of the paper or archive to cite.

icon.description: Square PNG in the repository (SVG is not accepted: it can carry scripts).

screenshots.description: Images in the repository; captions double as alt text.

repoPath.description: Path inside the repository, no leading slash.
